Fueling Deicing

Перекачка топлива между баками

The procedure or system of transferring fuel between tanks or sides of the aircraft to maintain balance or correct asymmetry during flight.

Definition

The procedure or system of transferring fuel between tanks or sides of the aircraft to maintain balance or correct asymmetry during flight.

Operational example

Initiate fuel crossflow from right to left tank to correct fuel imbalance.
